concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-doku-doku-api-only]] — 2019-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Indonesia DOKU API-only guide for ID/IDR variant selection, merchant-owned form and server request, with voucher-specific asynchronous webhook states, 48-hour default validity and BCA/BRI entity caveats.
warnings: PresentToShopper/PENDING voucher creation is not payment completion; AUTHORISATION true and OFFER_CLOSED true have different meanings. Voucher response/status table is not proven for every bank-transfer variant. PHP Alfamart type differs from prose/JSON and Go version/import path differs.
